summary_ja: 信用リスクについて、緩やかな景気後退シナリオを少なくとも考慮したストレス・テストを定期的に実施し、格付遷移等を考慮する。
summary_en: Requires regular credit risk stress tests reflecting at least a mild recession scenario, with requirements on rating migration, credit deterioration and external rating history.
paragraphs: In order to assess the effect of specific conditions on the required capital amount for credit risk, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall regularly conduct meaningful and appropriately conservative credit risk stress tests that take into account at least the effect of a mild recession scenario, for the portfolios that account for the majority of the exposures of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc.

In conducting the stress tests prescribed in the preceding paragraph, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall satisfy the following requirements: (i) Forecast rating migrations for at least some exposures using internal data; (ii) Obtain information on the effects that may arise if credit conditions worsen further, by considering the effect of a slight deterioration in credit conditions on the ratings of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company; (iii) Take into account the historical rating migrations of external ratings, by roughly mapping the ratings of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company to external rating categories or by other methods.
